# tebibcloud_prices (Data Source)

The public price list of the endpoint's region. There are two fixed lists: ETB for customers in Ethiopia and USD for every other country; `currency` picks one (default `USD`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tebibcloud_prices" "now" {}

output "b1_small_per_month" {
  value = data.tebibcloud_prices.now.monthly_by_meter["vm.b1.small"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `currency` (String) Which list: `ETB` (customers in Ethiopia) or `USD` (all other countries). Default `USD`.

### Read-Only

- `at` (String) Time the list is for.
- `egress_allowances` (Attributes List) Free egress per instance type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress_allowances))
- `hours_per_month` (Number) Hours in a billing month.
- `monthly_by_meter` (Map of String) Monthly price by meter, for meters that have one, e.g. `data.tebibcloud_prices.p.monthly_by_meter["vm.b1.small"]`.
- `prices` (Attributes List) Prices in force. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))
- `region` (String) Region the prices are for.
- `scheduled` (Attributes List) Announced future prices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduled))

<a id="nestedatt--egress_allowances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `egress_allowances`

Read-Only:

- `effective_from` (String) When it takes effect.
- `gb_per_month` (Number) Free GB a month.
- `instance_type` (String) Instance type.


<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency of the price (`ETB` or `USD`).
- `effective_from` (String) When the price takes effect.
- `meter` (String) What is metered, e.g. `vm.b1.small` or `volume.gib`.
- `monthly` (String) Price for a month of use, when it has one.
- `note` (String) Note.
- `unit` (String) Billing unit, e.g. `hour`.
- `unit_price` (String) Price per unit in the list's currency, as a decimal string.
- `unit_price_micro` (Number) Price per unit in millionths of the currency.


<a id="nestedatt--scheduled"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scheduled`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency of the price (`ETB` or `USD`).
- `effective_from` (String) When the price takes effect.
- `meter` (String) What is metered, e.g. `vm.b1.small` or `volume.gib`.
- `monthly` (String) Price for a month of use, when it has one.
- `note` (String) Note.
- `unit` (String) Billing unit, e.g. `hour`.
- `unit_price` (String) Price per unit in the list's currency, as a decimal string.
- `unit_price_micro` (Number) Price per unit in millionths of the currency.
